jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description: cignal.io - Team About core Features Technology For SSPs About Cignal Partners Meet Us Offices Careers Careers We provide digital advertising data driven solutions for the worldâs largest brands. If you understand that the future of advertising is in data and you are passionate about the online arena, come join our A team. Check out our open positions below or apply at jobs@cignal.io HR Manager Responsibilities Requirements Work closely with the team to define roles and review candidates, source and screen candidates from various channels. Build and manage Employee onboarding process. Manage recruitment and interview processes. Conduct initial introduction calls for various positions and perform reference calls. Manage team calendar, plan and execute team building events. Schedule and coordinate conferences, events, travel and other similar activities. Ensure a high level of employee engagement. Work with our team to execute cignal’ HR strategy, vision and values. Be the point of contact for all HR issues related to the entire employee lifecycle Out-of-the-box recruitment methods 2 years + experience in a growing startup! Experience in recruitment processes and applicant tracking systems is a plus. Excellent verbal and written communication skills required with strong interpersonal skills You are a team player who knows when to act independently and when to seek a second opinion Ability to learn new concepts quickly Ability to multi-task, set priorities and work in a dynamic office environment Excellent proactive follow-up skills is required Must be organized and detail-oriented Must have the ability to appropriately manage confidential information. Extensive experience in HR interviewing A keen sense of understanding of core business goals and priorities Fluent in English (written and verbal) apply at jobs@cignal.io Technical Account Manager Responsibilities Requirements Become an expert with cignal’ proprietary technology. Manage the onboarding, integration, support, and optimization of CORE partners - SSPs, DSPs, DMPs and direct programmatic buyers and sellers. Build relationships with technical and business contacts on Demand and Supply side, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor on all aspects of the programmatic ecosystem. Lead revenue initiatives related to programmatic partners. Provide expert level guidance to DSPs and SSPs on CORE console; knowing our offering’s full potential to be able to advise on the best technical solutions. Analyze large sets of performance data and communicate findings to internal teams and external partners. Debug and diagnose day to day CORE’s partners to resolve technical issues. Help improve our operations workflow through the development of new processes and best-practices. Suggest, and at times directly improve and create CORE’s external documentation and collateral materials set, including API specs, FAQ, partner procedure guides, etc. Communicate internally and externally the status and on-going timeline for integrations. 2 years+ of experience in the programmatic advertising space, with a management position. A strong understanding of OpenRTB protocol, DSPs, SSPs, Exchanges, DMPs & Measurement Providers Demonstrated ability to use data to troubleshoot and solve complex problems autonomously Business savvy with Proven success in managing client relationships Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to respond quickly in a fast-moving environment Experience in management of programmatic ad delivery, optimization and/or yield management Working with tech implementation and tagging integrations. Proven experience working on RTB integrations Ability to convey complex technical requirements and ideas to both technical and commercially focused positions internally and externally Experience in diagnosing and working through issues with third-party technology vendors including DSPs, DMPs, and ad servers Curious and aptitude for working with new emerging technologies and partnering with market leaders to drive solutions to fit partner’s business needs apply at jobs@cignal.io Senior Analyst Responsibilities Requirements Gather, organize, analyze and interpret trends to complex data-sets Set goals, analyze dashboards and reports and evaluate data in order to generate measurable, informative conclusions Analyze big data related to all aspects of the company's business, provide deep data based insights and recommendations to other business units Develop forecasts, statistical models, segmentation schemes, and data-driven analyses for a variety of challenges Optimize the company's products constantly along with the development, design and product teams Drive the company to higher results through intelligent data-based analysis Automate data collection and monitoring processes Assist other team members in planning, conducting reports and presenting their activities in the most optimal and professional manner Main point of contact for all future reporting and BI needs 3+ years of experience in the private sector, taking part of data-related projects Solid understanding of statistics/economy/computer science/applied mathematics Creative thinker who has proven ability to innovate through data exploration and application of non-trivial solutions Strong programming skills in Python/Java/Ruby or equivalent - an advantage Strong understanding of the online marketing industry Advantage – knowledge/familiarity of online marketing platforms; ad servers, DSPs and more Enthusiastic, creative, highly motivated individual with a serious work ethic Demonstrated success presenting complex data in clear compelling tones Great business overview and understanding of the "bigger picture" apply at jobs@cignal.io Data Scientist Responsibilities Requirements We are looking for a Data Scientist to join its science team, responsible for implementing deep learning algorithms on sparse, heterogeneous and trending data, discovering problems insights and id
